- Total revenue reached £41.6k TW versus £30.0k LW, a WoW gain of 38.5%.
- Total units hit 19,061 TW, up 54.9% WoW, while orders rose 6.8% WoW to 769 TW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER ranked 1 TW with £4,405.70, equal to 10.6% of TW revenue, and drew the most orders at 57 TW.
- PARTY BUNTING delivered £3,220.36 TW, a WoW increase of £1,523.87 or 89.8%.
- PLEASE ONE PERSON METAL SIGN added £1,475.70 TW, all of it incremental WoW, and COOK WITH WINE METAL SIGN gained £1,141.92 WoW.
- JUMBO BAG STRAWBERRY fell £1,679.65 WoW, down 68.8%, the largest decline TW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER posted £2,446.96 TW despite a WoW drop of £611.83, and JUMBO STORAGE BAG SUKI declined £565.01 WoW.
- The top five products, including JUMBO BAG PINK VINTAGE PAISLEY at £1,477.55 TW, accounted for 31.3% of TW revenue; PACK OF 72 RETRO SPOT CAKE CASES led volume with 1,859 units TW.
